title: Contact an Education Service Center
before:
The Education Service Centers (ESCs) included here became operational in FY 19. For detailed information about a particular ESC, including contact information for the executive director, a complete membership list, and a menu of services, click on its linked name below.

Membership in a particular ESC does not require the member to be physically located within the ESC's geographic area. However, most ESCs have been formed with members within those boundaries. The geographic areas have been designed around Maine's nine school superintendent's regions listed below: 

  1. Aroostook County 
  2. Penquis (Penobscot, Piscataquis, Somerset)
  3. Washington County
  4. Hancock County
  5. Mid-Coast (Knox, Lincoln, Sagadahoc)
  6. Western Maine (Androscoggin, Franklin, Oxford)
  7. Cumberland County
  8. Kennebec Valley (Kennebec, Waldo)
  9. York County

To view current Education Service Centers by location, click on the Education Service Center Interactive Map.

notes: 1162 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 7 links on this page open a file — 7 PDF — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 19 email addresses sit in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: The Education Service Centers (ESCs) included here became operational in FY 19. For detailed information about a particular ESC, including contact information for the executive director, a complete membership list, and a menu of services, click on its linked name below.

decisions.label: Let a long table be searched
decisions.why: 1 table runs to fifteen rows or more, so finding one row means reading every row. The theme already loads the search behaviour on every page and switches it on for any table marked this way — 26 tables across the site already are, including the contact directory. It adds a search box and a "show 25 entries" menu above the table, makes the column headings sortable, and pages below twenty-five rows at a time — which leaves all but the longest tables whole. Nothing is reordered and nothing changes until someone types.
